{{Quote|The drum corps has begun, I believe it's a percussion arrangement of 'Tialga Hath Fallen,' a traditional Aldeeranian air about a warrior-queen who makes a stand against impossible odds so her children can reach safe haven.|Javis Tyrr|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
"'''Tialga Hath Fallen'''" was a traditional air, originating from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], about the deeds of a warrior-[[Queen/Legends|queen]]. A percussion arrangement of the air was played by the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance Navy]] [[Galactic Alliance Navy Drum Corps|Drum Corps]] during [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]]'s [[Funeral of Cha Niathal|funeral]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. During the procession, the traditional [[Alderaanian flute]]s were substituted for by [[sequential bell]]s. [[Journalist/Legends|Journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] reported on the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] procession for the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], giving mention to the air.
